gen.prompt: # AES Encryption Utility Implementation ## Background We are developing a mobile app client that needs to exchange messages with the server using AES encryption. Please write an AES utility class to encrypt plaintext messages. ## Requirements Please implement the `encrypt` method in `com.example.service.AESService`: ```java public static String encrypt(String key, byte[] data) ``` ## Functional Requirements 1. Accept a byte array of the message and a string representing the encryption key. 2. Return the ciphertext as a hexadecimal string after encryption. 3. Include necessary exception handling. 4. The code should be concise and efficient. ## Technical Context - Java 8+ - Maven project structure ## Output Requirements Provide the complete Java class implementation, including: 1. Class name: `AESService` ## Output Format Output the complete code for `src/main/java/com/example/service/AESService.java` in the following format: ```xml path1 ```
